image_description: A full-body profile shot of a Blenheim spaniel (Cavalier King Charles Spaniel) standing on a green grassy lawn. The dog features the characteristic white coat with rich chestnut/red patches, particularly on the ears and head spots. It has long, heavily feathered ears, a domed head, and a docked tail held level with the back. The image is framed by a decorative brown border.
